title: Improve conditional κ to 0.001697147064845350 with whole-role augmenting paths
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The pinned PR2322 native words admit a better complete owner assignment. This construction raises the conditional published point to **κ = 0.001697147064845350**, above concurrent PR2349's full rational `0.0016970659941088806668214121951845796408…`. The gain over PR2349 is approximately `8.10707365e-8`, or **0.004777% of κ**. This is an incremental packing improvement.

The new witness consists of 43 complete width-7/9 alternating-path exchanges and 53 further width-preserving transfers. The proof accounts for both endpoints and all intermediate bins; every complete exchange strictly improves the power sum for every exponent in `(0,1)`. The actual 289,044 whole-helper roles, 1,332 event windows, family exclusions, widths and prefix offsets are replayed against the inherited independent owner checker.

The final complete profile is `{1:1576962,2:340992,3:292196,4:79920,5:28004,7:1,8:5328,23:1,32:13,48:24546}`. Its exact directed native root bracket is `(0.001697147064845350, 0.001697147064845351)`. Full changed-data supplier/controller/invoice/outer admission passes, with the published rational strictly below the admitted outer point. Dimension 73, 66,304 live families, 666 calls, 434 helpers/call, rank mass 4,816,512 and deficit 23,680 are unchanged. The bit endpoint remains `0.001733427039589844234749`.

The final invoice incorporates PR2349's four exact conservative pricing files: **66,826 physical fields**, including **78 dedicated cleanup buffers** in addition to the 434-field reserve; buffer allocation/release CLEARs, all warp-routing reserves and expanded adapter work are charged. These charges receive a fresh strict invoice and outer replay. The unchanged fixed-word packing cap is below `0.001720061111244974`; this construction realizes about **98.6678%** of that ceiling, with no optimality claim.

**Scope:** a complete finite construction and conditional outer bound. All inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/fixed-tape, recovery, analytic-transfer, recurrence and outer/bit premises remain. This is not an unconditional multiplication theorem, a practical timing result or maintainer acceptance. The selected frontier is untouched.

## Task and overlap

Donor-assigned goal: exceed the strongest observed κ, including pending candidates. Task `selected-packing`, **changed scope** to the stronger pending T74 supplier; base canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. One canonical investigation: [Discussion2325](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2325).

Exact source pins:

- PR2322 `002304ef01c4416a127916169ae6d94c1bee052b`: adopted native words, call order and complete replay integration.
- PR2312 `fb76f799ccf078f51780076ebed3fd26b1db11c0`: immutable native/runtime source; its historical head is deliberate.
- PR2288 `614c74a63b0f6d4a24c7740d7ddb90d37861b3c7`: immutable parent admission source.
- PR2349 `bb2486ec93c099afe9acd93442f13864b566296a`: four exactly pinned pricing files, applied only to a staged runtime.

PR2309 already gives the favorable `2 H7 → H14` arithmetic. This contribution supplies actual composed paths on the stronger PR2322 supplier and complete admission. PR2349 independently shares the 17 rank-four filling moves; no exclusive priority is claimed for those. The additional composed paths produce the stronger complete profile. Source manifests, Git blobs and all copied predecessor notices are retained.

Overlap evidence covers a fully paginated 564 open PRs and 1,078 Discussion records, then a fresh 100-most-recently-updated-PR check through PR2361; relevant heads and bodies were read. This is not an exhaustive code-diff novelty certificate. PR2359 separately confirms the adopted raw paid-frame delta. PR2360's new scoped cap for the PR2339 inventory is reflected in the next questions.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14 on macOS arm64; full replay used NumPy2.3.5, SciPy1.18.1, SymPy1.14.0, mpmath1.3.0, Apple clang21 and Boost1.87.0. No optimizer is required for verification.

- Fully cold pinned PR2288 parent admission passed.
- Both PR2322 native programs were freshly regenerated, including exact all-column/phase, local, wrapper and complete 17-artifact source bindings.
- Final changed-data strict admission used those complete authenticated caches and reran owners, controller, the conservatively priced invoice, exact moment and fine-prime outer with its independent checker.
- Deterministic standard-library discovery reproduces all 43+53 paths exactly.
- Registered package replay, metadata/pins and isolated optimized (`-I -O -B`) bounded replay pass, including nine rejecting controls and exact publication/physical-invoice bindings.
- The documented source exporter reconstructs all three immutable packages; staged input bytes preserve original CRLFs. A fresh archive of committed head `d815dbe3` also passes isolated optimized replay.

Quick replay:

```sh
python3.12 -B research/t74-owner-augmenting-paths/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-owner-augmenting-paths
```

The package README gives deterministic discovery, source export, fully cold replay and explicit source-bound cache-reuse commands. `VALIDATION.md` distinguishes the separate executions; `evidence/FULL-ADMISSION.json` binds the final strict invoice and outer ledger. Hosted CI and independent human review are not claimed in advance.

## Open next questions

The README and TASK.json identify a coupled mixed-width exchange beyond the current paths, and a partial alias selection or changed parent stock screened with whole-width pattern costs. The full PR2339 inventory on unchanged T74 bins is covered by PR2360's reported cap below 0.0016870, so it is no longer presented as an immediate stronger candidate.
